model_selection: Run all general APU tests on CGB-E, as documented by SameSuite/apu/README.md. Run explicitly cgb-suffixed ROMs on their named CGB revisions. The bare -A suffix is ambiguous: retain the earlier CGB-A run as exploratory and add a targeted AGB-A run, excluding both from the applicable CGB/DMG suite count. Contemporaneous author/source history strongly suggests -A means Advance, but the filename itself is not explicit. Run only div_write_trigger and div_write_trigger_10 on DMG-B, the cases explicitly documented for pre-CGB hardware. Other APU ROMs require CGB PCM registers and are not DMG accuracy evidence.

settings_authority.duration: Unmodified Tester default 60*40 approximate frames (40 emulated seconds); no --length override. Terminal HALT with interrupts disabled is detected by Tester and ends the run early after rendering. Blank screens receive the project-defined four-second extension.
settings_authority.boot: Unmodified Tester selects the supplied built-in boot ROM appropriate to --model.
settings_authority.exit_status: Tester exits zero after processing a ROM regardless of pass/fail, so process success is not treated as test success.
